name: Platinic-Mausoleum
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past towering mountain ranges, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Established during the last boom, the pirate hideout was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
For traders, nitrogen, carbon and dark crystals alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
